title: Receive stock
subtitle: Scan what arrived, enter how many, and add it to stock.
readyToReceive: Ready to receive. Scan an item to begin.
addFailed: Couldn't add that stock. Try again.

delivery.title: Receive a delivery
delivery.subtitle: Build the list of what arrived, then add it all to stock at once.

add.label: Scan or search for an item
add.placeholder: Scan a barcode, or type a name or SKU
add.hint: Scan the same item again to add one more. Enter adds the highlighted item.

import.title: Add from a list
import.description: Paste rows from a spreadsheet, or upload a CSV file. Each row needs a barcode or SKU, then a quantity. A header row is optional, and a row with no quantity counts as 1.
import.empty: There are no rows to add.
import.result: Added {matched, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} to the list.
import.resultUnmatched: Added {matched, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} to the list. {unmatched, plural, one {# row needs} other {# rows need}} your attention.

list.label: Items in this delivery
list.empty: Nothing on the list yet. Scan the first item to begin.

unmatched.title: {count, plural, one {# row couldn't be matched} other {# rows couldn't be matched}}
unmatched.hint: Nothing in the catalog has that barcode or SKU. Find the right item, or remove the row.
unmatched.badQuantity: The quantity isn't a whole number
unmatched.resolving: Pick the item for “{code}”. It will be added with a quantity of {quantity}.

delivery.summary: {items, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} · {units, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}}
delivery.fixQuantities: {count, plural, one {Fix # quantity} other {Fix # quantities}} to continue.
delivery.clearDescription: This removes every row from the list. Nothing on it has been added to stock yet.
delivery.draftRestored: Picked up where you left off: {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} from an unfinished delivery.

result.all: Received {items, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} · {units, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}}.
result.partial: Received {received, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}. {failed, plural, one {# row needs} other {# rows need}} attention.

errors.notFound: This item is no longer in the catalog.
errors.unconfirmed: Couldn't confirm this was saved. Check the item's stock before retrying.

dialog.sessionOpen: Logged to the restock session open since {date}.
dialog.noSession: No restock session is open; the stock is still added.
dialog.skipHint: Leave a quantity empty to skip that item.
dialog.invalidQuantity: Enter a whole number up to {max}.
